rule: Glossary terms are written normalized, are unique in their course, and each names an existing node.

cases.name: term-not-normalized
cases.expect: unit-1.json › glossary[0] › term: write it normalized, as 'hola'

cases.name: term-defined-twice-in-the-course
cases.expect: unit-2.json › glossary[0] › term: 'hola' is already defined at unit-1.json › glossary[0]

cases.name: unknown-node
cases.expect: unit-1.json › glossary[0] › node: there is no node 'u9.nowhere' in this course
